function J$({ api: e, install: t, publish: n, path: a = "/api/admin/base-map/atlas", decode: o = (s) => createImageBitmap(s) }) {
  let s = null, r = "spring", i = null, l = 0, c = null;
  async function d() {
    if (!s) return;
    const u = s.editorAssets?.seasonAtlases?.[r];
    if (!u || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(u.sha256) || !Number.isSafeInteger(u.byteLength) || u.byteLength < 1 || u.byteLength > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {
      n({ atlasError: "圖集描述無效", atlasLoading: !1 });
      return;
    }
    const p = r + ":" + u.sha256;
    if (i === p) return;
    i = p;
    const g = ++l, h = r;
    t(null), c?.close(), c = null, n({ atlasLoading: !0, atlasError: "", season: r });
    try {
      const f = await e(a + "?season=" + h, void 0, { binary: !0, maxBytes: u.byteLength, feedback: "local" });
      if (g !== l) return;
      if (f.bytes.length !== u.byteLength || f.sha256 !== u.sha256) throw new Error("圖集長度或摘要不符");
      const m = Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", f.bytes)), (w) => w.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
      if (g !== l) return;
      if (m !== u.sha256) throw new Error("圖集內容校驗失敗");
      const v = await o(new Blob([f.bytes], { type: "image/png" }));
      if (g !== l) {
        v.close();
        return;
      }
      if (v.width !== 256 || v.height !== 256)
        throw v.close(), new Error("圖集尺寸無效");
      c = v, t(c);
    } catch (f) {
      g === l && (i = null, n({ atlasError: f.message }));
    } finally {
      g === l && n({ atlasLoading: !1 });
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    setSource(u) {
      if (s = u, s) return d();
      l++, i = null, t(null), c?.close(), c = null, n({ atlasLoading: !1, atlasError: "", season: r });
    },
    setSeason(u) {
      if (!["spring", "summer", "autumn", "winter"].includes(u)) throw new Error("季節無效");
      return r = u, d();
    },
    retry: d
  });
}
